reviewContext.userProblem: Telescreen v1 needs its last deliverables: assembly re-verified with a gate-clean report, end-to-end flow tests, the raw-value leak matrix, and runnable compose/workflow examples with README and final gates.
requiredOutcomes: p28-assembly: re-run its Verification block on the current tree; report only final passing commands (conventions 7a).
p28b: GitHub remediation (human task, SLA escalation, evidence gate, police send-back then pass), sweep, ingestion and chat E2E flows through the real container, offline.
p28c: raw-value leak matrix over DB, logs, search docs, outbound bodies, evidence files, API responses, tracebacks and exception output, with non-empty sink guards.
p29: examples/compose and examples/workflows reconciled, README updated, full Python and web gates plus screenshot smoke (or recorded gap).
nonGoals: Re-implementing any of the 29 integration-accepted plans listed in acceptedDependencies.
Dependency changes to pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/web/package.json or bun.lock.
constraints: AGENTS.md: English only, no emojis, python-coding-standards, plans under 400 lines, Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing via tools/typelint.py, ruff ANN/PGH and ty; no weakening, no type-ignore comments, no new per-file-ignores.
Raw detected values never persisted, logged, indexed, notified or returned; only masked values and HMAC fingerprints.
Default uv run pytest passes offline; integration tests marked and skipped without TELESCREEN_TEST_DATABASE_URL / TELESCREEN_TEST_MEILI_URL.
Example configs use placeholders and secret references only; no committed secrets; test secrets built at runtime.
Conventions 7a: fixed findings only in addressedFeedback; verification lists only final passing commands; mutation and superseded runs only in the Progress Log; build outputs to /tmp.
The working tree was clean at cdf195d; design-docs/** must stay unmodified.
A defect found outside a plan's writePaths becomes a Reconciliation request in that plan's Progress Log, not an in-place fix.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Design reused unchanged (step2 D1, accepted by step3 comm-005814).
p28-assembly re-verify only (D2): mutation evidence already lives only in its Progress Log; the earlier block came from the step-result contents.
Traces sink = rendered tracebacks, exception messages, 500 body and MockTransport bodies (design-masking.md, D3).
Waves B3-1 {p28-assembly}, B3-2 {p28b, p28c}, B3-3 {p29}: acyclic, file-disjoint; p29 last because it runs whole-repository gates.
intentionalTradeoffs: Screenshot smoke or docker compose config may be unavailable locally; recorded as verification gaps per design-ui-sentry.md 8.5.
p28c expresses scanner-unavailable and free-text image cases through the HTTP seam (stricter than design-masking.md allows).
supportedEdgeCases: SLA breach escalates a human task to the next tier via masked Slack/email (p28b).
Evidence containing a credential is rejected, then clean evidence is accepted (p28b, p28c).
Police verify_remediation fails once (send-back) and then passes (p28b).
Sweep removal reconciliation auto-resolves issues; partial sweeps skip reconciliation; concurrent start returns 409 (p28b).
Separator-stripped variants of sample secrets are also searched in every sink; empty sinks fail the guard (p28c).
Scanner unavailable yields 503 fail-closed; image metadata is stripped; pushed raw findings are rejected (p28c).
Screenshot smoke exit 2 (no browser) or missing docker is recorded only as a verificationGap (p29).
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Live PostgreSQL/Meilisearch behavior beyond the marked integration tests skipped offline.
Real external services (Slack, Google, GitHub, Anthropic, SMTP) and real docker compose up.
